libs.note:
BH-4009 (BH-3988.1). The tickets section of the hourly utilization snapshot (ready/blocked/held/parked per project), sourced by bin/utilization-push.sh. Applied per project by util_section_tickets through lib_env_apply utilization-tickets

.

knobs.note: GitHub reads per project per hourly run for out-of-list Blocked-by states and hold threads, together. Past it the unchecked candidates count as ready and held_complete is false. Settings key lib.utilization-tickets[.<project>].util_hold_reads_max. Read as ${UTIL_HOLD_READS_MAX:-30}; the literal is the documented fallback.
